headline: Argentine Dollar Bonds Fall Amid Global Pressures and Political Uncertainty
summary: Argentine dollar bonds dropped over 2% as global market pressures mounted and investors remained cautious ahead of the 2027 political scenario, while businesses paused investments.
why: Sovereign bond performance and country risk metrics reflect investor confidence in a nation's fiscal solvency and political stability.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Rising country risk and falling bond prices signal deteriorating investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Worsening external conditions and local political uncertainty caused dollar-denominated sovereign bonds to fall more than 2%.
